entities.name: Brinelin
entities.description: Millennia-old Zendikar moon kraken ruling the seas off Akoum, who fears Sorin.

entities.name: Sutina
entities.description: Fallen Tajuru leader and friend of the kraken.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: Zendikar region off whose shores Brinelin rules.

events.summary: Brinelin demands tribute from Nissa, Sorin and Anowon, and Sorin kills a goblin, which is found lacking.
events.quote: Sorin casually killed a goblin to satisfy the great creature

events.summary: Nissa speaks of Sutina's death and Brinelin agrees to lead them through the crystal reefs.
events.quote: Brinelin finally acquiesced to lead them safely through the crystal reefs

relations.quote: Sorin Markov , is one of those things
who had been friends with the kraken
